name: iOS MobileViews — per-view traces & interaction breakdown
description: Per-view load spans and screen-to-screen flow from feature/mobileview-trace-segments. All widgets target account 10816994 - change every "accountId" if you import elsewhere.

pages.name: Breakdown
pages.description: One screen load, several component rows — the NRQL equivalent of the Interactions breakdown table.

rawConfiguration.text:
## How to read this page

Every tracked view records a **load span** as a segment on whichever interaction is open, emitting a scoped `Method/MobileView/<viewName>` metric. On `ListingDetailScreen` the screen opens the interaction (`startsInteraction: true`) and its five sections take the default `startsInteraction: false`, so all five land in **one** interaction — that is the multi-row breakdown.

**Two things to know.**

1. The rows in New Relic's own Interactions breakdown table come from *metric timeslice* data, which NRQL does not read. This page rebuilds the same picture from events, which is what the new `interactionId` / `viewName` correlation attributes made possible. The **Metric reachability** widget on page 2 tells you whether the real timeslice metrics are queryable in your account.
2. `loadTime` and `interactionId` ride on the **appear** event (`appeared IS TRUE`); `timeVisible` rides on the **disappear** event. Filters below are explicit about which they need.

Component rows carry `component = true` and `componentOf = 'Listing Detail'`; screen rows have no `component` attribute at all.

widgets.title: Breakdown table — one interaction, its component rows

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(loadTime) AS 'Load (ms)', latest(interactionName) AS 'Interaction', latest(componentOf) AS 'Component of', latest(uiPlatform) AS 'Platform' FROM MobileView WHERE appeared IS TRUE AND interactionId IS NOT NULL FACET interactionId, viewName SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 100
SELECT uniqueCount(viewName) FROM MobileView WHERE appeared IS TRUE AND component IS TRUE AND interactionId IS NOT NULL FACET interactionId SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 20
SELECT average(loadTime) FROM MobileView WHERE appeared IS TRUE AND component IS TRUE FACET viewName SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 20
SELECT average(loadTime) FROM MobileView WHERE appeared IS TRUE AND component IS TRUE FACET viewName TIMESERIES SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT average(interactionDuration) * 1000 FROM Mobile WHERE category = 'Interaction' FACET name SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 20

widgets.title: Reverse join — the interaction event now names its view

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(interactionDuration) * 1000 AS 'Duration (ms)', latest(previousView) AS 'Referrer', latest(viewInstanceId) AS 'View instance' FROM Mobile WHERE category = 'Interaction' AND viewName IS NOT NULL FACET name, viewName SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 50

pages.name: Views & navigation
pages.description: Screen-level view behaviour, plus data-health checks for the MobileViews pipeline.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM MobileView WHERE appeared IS TRUE AND previousView IS NOT NULL AND component IS NULL FACET previousView, viewName SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 50
SELECT average(timeVisible) FROM MobileView WHERE appeared IS FALSE AND component IS NULL FACET viewName SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 20
SELECT count(*) FROM MobileView FACET uiPlatform SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT count(*) FROM MobileView WHERE restarted IS TRUE AND component IS NULL FACET viewName SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 20

widgets.title: Views with no interaction to join to

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM MobileView WHERE appeared IS TRUE AND interactionId IS NULL FACET viewName SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 20

widgets.title: Metric reachability — are the breakdown metrics in NRDB?

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT uniques(metricTimesliceName) FROM Metric WHERE metricTimesliceName LIKE 'Method/MobileView/%' SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Double-report check — instances per view per interaction

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT uniqueCount(viewInstanceId) AS 'Instances' FROM MobileView WHERE appeared IS TRUE AND component IS NULL AND interactionId IS NOT NULL FACET interactionId, viewName SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 50

pages.name: Flow
pages.description: Screen-to-screen movement rebuilt from the previousView -> viewName edge on every MobileView appear event.

rawConfiguration.text:
## How to read this page

Every `MobileView` **appear** event carries both ends of a transition: `viewName` (where the user
landed) and `previousView` (where they came from). That pair *is* a directed edge, so the screen-flow
graph needs no derivation — only aggregation.

**Every query here is guarded with `component IS NULL`.** Component rows (`component = true`,
`componentOf = 'Listing Detail'`) are segments *inside* one screen load, not steps in the user's
journey. Leave them in and the five Listing Detail sections become five phantom screens branching
off `ListingDetailScreen`.

**Reading the matrix.** Rows are the *from* screen, columns the *to* screen. Bright cells are the
well-trodden paths; a row that is empty across every column is a screen users only ever leave by
backgrounding the app.

**Walking one session.** Pick a `sessionId` from *Busiest sessions*, then paste it into the
*Session walk* query as `AND sessionId = '<id>'`. The table is already ordered by time, so it reads
top-to-bottom as the actual route taken.

**Want an actual node-and-arrow picture?** NRQL has no Sankey. Run `scripts/mobileview_flow.py`
against an event dump (or the results of the *Top transitions* query) to get a Mermaid `flowchart`
you can paste into GitHub, Confluence, or a PR description.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM MobileView WHERE appeared IS TRUE AND component IS NULL AND previousView IS NOT NULL FACET previousView, viewName SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT MAX
SELECT count(*) FROM MobileView WHERE appeared IS TRUE AND component IS NULL AND previousView IS NULL FACET viewName SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 20

widgets.title: Top transitions — traversals and how slow the landing was

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Traversals', average(loadTime) AS 'Avg load (ms)', max(loadTime) AS 'Worst load (ms)' FROM MobileView WHERE appeared IS TRUE AND component IS NULL AND previousView IS NOT NULL FACET previousView, viewName SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 100

widgets.title: Busiest sessions — pick one to walk

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Screen views', uniqueCount(viewName) AS 'Distinct screens' FROM MobileView WHERE appeared IS TRUE AND component IS NULL FACET sessionId SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 20
SELECT timestamp, previousView, viewName, loadTime, interactionName, uiPlatform FROM MobileView WHERE appeared IS TRUE AND component IS NULL SINCE 1 day ago ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 100
